title: Longer Strength II Potions
description: Changes level 2 strength potions to last 8 minutes instead of 1.5 minutes
body:
## Longer Strength II
Strength II potions, splash potions, lingering potions and tipped arrows last longer. The duration becomes the same as a long level 1 of its type.

_This mechanic was inspired by Lifesteal World, where Strength II splash potions would last 8 minutes_


<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

_The potions will look 1.5 minutes when they have been brewed and are still in the brewing stand, but they will work as intended as soon as they enter a player's inventory._

![Becomes 8 Minutes when entering inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6c13e76abd2c314f56cf26b4fde7aba92395a3f.gif)

</details>
<details>
<summary>Installation</summary>
  
### Server Installation (Datapack)
  
1. Go in the main server file
  
2. Open _world_ -> _datapacks_

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

### World Installation (Datapack)

1. Press Win + R and enter %appdata%

2. Open _.minecraft_ -> _saves_ -> _<world name>_ -> datapacks

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

(Note that if you are using a launcher like Modrinth App or Prism Launcher, you'll need to go on your instance on the launcher and click on _Open Folder_.)

### Server Installation (Mod)

1. Go in the main server file

2. Open _mods_

3. Upload the mod in the _mods_ folder
</details>
